user_prompt:
A circular pond has a radius of 10 meters. There is an average of 2 frogs per square meter in the pond. Approximately how many frogs are in the pond?

π is approximately 3.14

A. 120
B. 300
C. 600
D. 2400

answer.description: The letter of the option you choose for the question.
answer.title: Answer

llm_thinking: The area works out to π·100 ≈ 314 m², so doubling gives about 628, which rounds to roughly 600. That points to answer C.
